import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class p1096g_v1 {
    static final long MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int k = in.nextInt();
        
        boolean[] allowed = new boolean[10];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            allowed[in.nextInt()] = true;
        }
        
        int half = n / 2;
        long[] dp = new long[9 * half + 1];
        dp[0] = 1;
        
        for (int pos = 0; pos < half; pos++) {
            long[] newDp = new long[9 * half + 1];
            for (int sum = 0; sum <= 9 * half; sum++) {
                if (dp[sum] == 0) continue;
                for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
                    if (allowed[digit]) {
                        if (sum + digit <= 9 * half) {
                            newDp[sum + digit] = (newDp[sum + digit] + dp[sum]) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            dp = newDp;
        }
        
        long total = 0;
        for (long val : dp) {
            total = (total + (val * val) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
